items.text: New on every topic: a Perspective on how management evolved (past, present and future), section subtitles in the trial list, and newest trials first within each section. Relapsed myeloma adds two 2026 phase 3 trials (SUCCESSOR-2, EXCALIBER-RRMM). Every page now carries an education-only disclaimer.
New on every topic: a "Drug mechanism" link in each trial card to a recent review of how the drug works and how resistance develops.

Remaining gaps filled from the full papers: toxicity for 9 trials and follow-up or effect sizes for 4 (Nordic MCL2, LyMa, I-PRISM, thalidomide-pamidronate, GRIFFIN, MRC VII, IFM 99-06, BNLI, TROG 99.03, POD24, EORTC 20981).

New on every topic: copy a link to any trial, an abbreviations list, "Report an error" links, free legal full-text copies where they exist, "Trials to watch" (ongoing phase 3 trials), and regulatory dates checked against FDA and EMA announcements.
New on every topic: key toxicity for each trial, a ★ Core trials filter, evidence tags, search across all topics, and Print / PDF.
33 entries completed from the full papers (follow-up, hazard ratios, sample sizes).
Free full-text, publisher and trial-registry links added to every trial.
